items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps skin fresh without stripping it.
Hyaluronic serum adds water-binding hydration, which can help skin look brighter and less dull.
A ceramide moisturizer supports the skin barrier and leaves skin looking smoother.
A mineral SPF 50 protects skin from daily sun and helps keep tone looking even.

response.routine_note: We removed the 30% AHA + 2% BHA peel because a high-strength acid peel that includes salicylic acid is not a good fit during pregnancy, so please check with your healthcare provider before using any peel. In the meantime, cleanse, apply the hyaluronic serum and moisturizer morning and night, and finish with the mineral SPF in the morning.
